metadata.description: CJ's skills and mods for Claude Code: planning in any tracker, a decision log, proving work in the real app, and guards for secrets, memory and Linear writes.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Sign off UI work — check spacing, type, colour and motion against the design, and paint scenes in code.

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Prove the work in the real app — playbooks for bugs and features, careless-user QA, diff review and PRs.

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Turn an idea into tickets — test if it is worth building, write the spec, cut thin slices in any tracker.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Keep what the team learns — a decision log, research pages, and lessons from your past sessions.

plugins.name: linear-gate
plugins.description: Holds every Linear write until you allow it.

plugins.name: session-modes
plugins.description: /mode readonly, research or edit, enforced for the rest of the session.

plugins.name: hone-nudge
plugins.description: Suggests /hone <skill> when you corrected Claude during a cj-stack skill run.

plugins.name: memory-lint
plugins.description: Denies an auto-memory write that holds task state, one-off references or repo detail.

plugins.name: work-folder
plugins.description: Denies a new agent working file (plan, evidence, prototype, scratch, report, probe test) outside .claude/work/, which is gitignored, with a per-repo allow list, and at session start removes .claude/work/ entries not changed for a day.

plugins.name: kill-guard
plugins.description: Denies a Bash command that stops processes by name or by port, because it can also stop another checkout's dev server; a kill of a named PID passes.

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Denies a Bash git command that loses work: git branch -D, a force push to main or master, and git checkout -- . or git restore . on a dirty tree; each deny names the safe alternative.

plugins.name: test-guard
plugins.description: Denies an Edit, MultiEdit or Write that changes or removes a line a test file has at HEAD; additions pass, and only the user can allow one file with /test-guard allow <path>.

plugins.name: bash-trim
plugins.description: Cuts a long successful Bash output to its first 2,000 and last 3,000 characters with a cut count; read-like commands, failures and saved outputs pass whole.
